title: Kelly Johnson's A-3 Design – handwritten Lockheed design sheet with aircraft sketch, 1958
description: Reproduction of a handwritten Lockheed engineering sheet titled "Kelly Johnson's A-3 Design," headed "Design of A-3" and dated September 1958. Listed characteristics include area 500 sq ft, gross weight 17,000 lb, two afterburning JT-12A engines, two 30" ramjets, a 300 lb payload and Mach 3.0 at 100,000 ft, with the note "Basic concept - reduce radar c.s." A rough planform sketch of the aircraft appears at the bottom. Chapter 6, page 266.
